Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno and to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (as target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
